Name: Community Park Decorations for Content Patcher
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Community Park Decorations for Content Patcher
[/b][/size][size=3]Decorate the public spaces of Pelican Town with the Community Park Catalogue, available at Robin's Carpenter Shop.  Adds over 100 unique Vanilla-style decor items.[/size]

[b][size=5]How to use[/size]
[/b][size=3]Purchase the Park Catalogue from the Robin's Shop , or spawn it in with CJB.  (optional via config - Park decor can be included in the in-game Furniture Catalog)[/size]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[/b][size=3]Content Patcher
Calcifer[/size]

[b][size=5]Features[/size]
[/b][list]
[*][size=3]Adds 100+ new furniture items, including Park Signs, Market Stalls, Playground equipment, Picnic Tables, Greenery and more [/size]
[*][size=3]Farmer's Market Stalls sell unique items and can be configured to sell "rare" and unobtainable goods. [/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with Happy Home Designer[/size]
[*][size=3]All pixel-art is based off of vanilla game sprites[/size]
[/list]
